comments.author: allenzren
comments.body:
I updated the configs https://github.com/irom-princeton/dppo/commit/e7f73dffc131570ef7129d5ed1bc98a05cf030ab. Basically the batch size had to be multiplied by the number of fine-tuned denoising steps, thus the effective batch size matches the original ones used in the paper.
![Screenshot 2024-12-24 at 1 36 53 AM](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a0a00750-21ba-4c2a-8292-201fb4a27d34)

Thanks for pointing this out too! We should've updated the D3IL configs when we introduced the new gradient update (https://github.com/irom-princeton/dppo/releases/tag/v0.6).
